mapping_basis: The two wrappers load the stored SBBF trait-object data/vtable, bucket count and bitmap. The first has the explicit length-one branch; the second is the original loop. Other baseline wrappers do not call this stored trait object.
wrapper_prologue: Both retain six callee-saved pushes and 0x58 stack bytes; no zero-prologue speed claim.
conclusion: Public upstream dynamic dispatch remains in both paths; singleton control changes branch/loop structure but does not bypass private kernels. No measured performance conclusion.
